## [CAS-01] Resolve selectors, cascade, and computed styles for static scenes

**Status:** DONE

Resolution

What changed:

- Added src/resolver/ module: mod.rs (resolve_scene, ResolvedScene, ResolvedNode, ResolverError), model.rs (ComputedStyle with Default), selector.rs (Specificity, selector_matches, specificity), cascade.rs (apply_declaration, apply_inheritance, parse_px, parse_color, shorthand helpers).
- Added src/resolver/tests/: mod.rs, selector.rs (type/class/compound/specificity tests), cascade.rs (parse, shorthand expansion, inheritance tests), integration.rs (5 fixture-driven integration tests).
- Exposed pub mod resolver in src/lib.rs.

Why:

- CAS-01 requires a resolver layer between the parsed source graph and the IR. resolve_scene() implements full v0.1 cascade: selector matching by type/class/compound, specificity ordering, shorthand expansion (margin, padding, border, background), inherit keyword handling, and typography inheritance (color, font-family, font-size, font-weight, line-height) propagated top-down through the DOM.
- ComputedStyle uses typed Rust fields (f32 for lengths, Option<String> for colors/keywords) with Default providing all CSS initial values. EXT-01 (CAS-01's direct consumer) maps these to IR types.

Verification:

- neti check -> PASS (cargo clippy -D warnings PASS, cargo test PASS, scan Clean, 37 files, 0 violations).
- Integration tests confirm: profile_card_absolute resolves .profile-card to position=absolute/background=#ffffff/border=1px #e5e7eb; .button.primary background=#111827 overrides .button (cascade specificity); font-family inherits body -> .button.primary; stacked_info_card .card resolves display=flex/flex-direction=column/gap=12px.

Handoff:

- LAY-01 (geometry) and EXT-01 (extractor) can now consume ResolvedScene from semui::resolver::resolve_scene.

**Resolution:**

## [LAY-01] Compute layout and geometry for the v0.1 static subset

**Status:** DONE
**Labels:** v0.1.0, layout, geometry, static
**Recorded:** 2026-04-08T21:23:45.3330956Z
**Closed:** 2026-04-09T04:45:29.863789661Z
**Depends on:** [CAS-01]

Resolution

What changed:

- Added src/layout/ module: mod.rs (compute_layout, node_geometry, absolute_coord, content_box), model.rs (Geometry, LaidOutNode, LaidOutScene).
- Added src/layout/tests/: mod.rs, geometry.rs (9 unit tests), integration.rs (5 fixture-driven tests).
- Exposed pub mod layout in src/lib.rs.

Why:

- LAY-01 requires a geometry layer between CAS-01 (ComputedStyle) and EXT-01 (SceneIr). For the v0.1 fixture corpus, all sizing is in explicit px — no font-metric computation needed. Layout reduces to two operations: (1) extracting top/left as explicit coordinates for position:absolute elements, (2) normalizing border-box width/height into content-box dimensions by subtracting padding and border. Non-absolute elements produce explicit_x/explicit_y = None; content-driven dimensions produce None content_width/height. DIA-01 will report these.
- compute_layout is infallible — every node produces a Geometry, some fields None.

Verification:

- neti check -> PASS (cargo clippy -D warnings PASS, cargo test PASS, scan Clean, 42 files, 0 violations).
- Integration tests confirm: .profile-card geometry is explicit_x=24, explicit_y=20, width=320, height=180, content_width=318, content_height=178 (border-box with 1px border); .avatar content_width=48 (no border/padding); .card in stacked_info_card content_width=278 (320-40padding-2border).

Handoff:

- EXT-01 (Extract resolved scenes into explicit SEMUI IR) is now fully unblocked — it depends on IR-01 (done), CAS-01 (done), and LAY-01 (done).

**Resolution:**

## [EXT-01] Extract resolved scenes into explicit SEMUI IR

**Status:** DONE
**Labels:** v0.1.0, extractor, normalization, ir
**Recorded:** 2026-04-08T21:23:45.4218383Z
**Closed:** 2026-04-09T14:26:11.672885836Z
**Depends on:** [CAS-01], [LAY-01], [IR-01]

Implement HTML/CSS -> SEMUI extraction on top of the parser, resolver, layout engine, and IR schema. The extractor should remove cascade ambiguity and browser defaults by emitting explicit nodes with resolved geometry, paint, typography, and structural semantics.

**Resolution:** Implemented src/extractor/mod.rs (extract_ir) and src/extractor/map.rs (type mapping layer). extract_ir walks html_nodes in document order, skips invisible structural tags (head/meta/link/title/style/script) and their descendants, maps element nodes to IrNode (Box or Control kind), maps non-whitespace text runs to Text IrNodes with parent typography, wires parent_id via html_to_ir_id. map.rs converts ComputedStyle+Geometry to Layout/Paint/Typography; border emitted only when width>0; border_radius only when >0; line_height parses px suffix. 87 tests pass, clippy clean.

**Depends on:** [CAS-01], [LAY-01], [EXT-01]

Make loss visible instead of silent. For every unsupported property, selector pattern, layout mode, or normalization fallback in v0.1, emit structured diagnostics that explain the source, the dropped semantics, and whether the round-trip still stays within the accepted loss budget.

**Resolution:** Implemented src/diagnostics/mod.rs with analyze(graph) -> Vec<Diagnostic>. Reports: UnsupportedProperty (property not in cascade.rs known set, e.g. appearance), UnsupportedValue (known property with unmapped value, e.g. display:grid, position:relative), UnsupportedSelector (selector contains #/:/ /[/>). Integration tests confirm profile_card has exactly 1 diagnostic (appearance:none), stacked_info_card is clean, action_row also flags appearance. 138 tests, clippy clean.
